HUD.Title: Portrait Expression
HUD.ResetSizeHint: Restore the sprite to 0 degrees and its original 100% width and height

ExpressionPicker.Title: Choose Expression
ExpressionPicker.Hint: Select an expression from its face thumbnail. No Expression removes the head layer.

Library.Title: Portrait Sprite Library
Library.Empty: No reusable portrait sprites have been created yet.

Creator.Title: Portrait Sprite Creator
Creator.BodyFrameHint: The common FGO layout uses the top 768px for the body. When possible, the creator tightens this to the visible body pixels so transparent margins do not create an oversized selection area.
Creator.ExpressionCountHint: Only the first Count cells are used. The current grid can hold up to {capacity} expressions, so a partially filled final row does not need dummy expressions.
Creator.PreviewHint: Preview shows the original image at its natural aspect ratio, with the body box in red, the head grid box in pink, and used expression frames in cyan.
Creator.PreviewPlaceholder: Select a spritesheet to preview the grid.

Errors.MissingSpritesheet: Select a spritesheet before creating a sprite.

Creator.ImageDimensionsUnknown: Original image dimensions unavailable until a spritesheet is loaded.
Creator.FinalPreviewHint: Cycles through only the configured expression count once per second using the current body, head grid, and head offset settings.
Creator.MagnifierHint: Move over the final preview to inspect pixels; use the mouse wheel to adjust zoom.
